messages.author: beb312d405ec6e0d
messages.subject: Multilevel multigroup CFA
parts:
Hi all,

Is it currently possible to run a multilevel, multigroup CFA with sem in lavaan?
I tried combining cluster = "subject" and group = "sex" but keep getting the following error (consistently with different datasets, models etc): 
Error in ov.names.l[[g]] : subscript out of bounds

If I run the model with only one of the statements it works. Now I am not sure if that is because it is not possible to combine the cluster and the group statement or if there is some other problem with the models I am fitting. 

Your help would be much appreciated!

Gudrun
